purpose: Single independent v2 imports-only attempt: tolerate only ENOENT during volatile cache accounting, preserving non-ENOENT failures; reuse complete SHA-verified v1 package archives without network.

isolation.runtime_shared_by: explicit read-only-intent symlinks for28 locked project runtime distributions; no project .pth overlay
isolation.shared_identity: Installed METADATA/RECORD/WHEEL hashes; existing runtime file content hashes inside RECORD are declared rather than all recomputed.
isolation.preflight_launch: isolated Python -I -S with explicit isolated site path; no executable .pth processing
isolation.threads_and_affinity: maximum2 available CPUs, all BLAS/OMP/PyTorch CPU thread pools limited to2
isolation.guard_scope: Python audit hooks and known Torch/safetensors constructor/load/forward/CUDA interfaces; these are application guards, not a kernel sandbox.

package_plan.source_installation: exact separately SHA-bound Python package subtrees only; generated dist-info states installation type; no setup/backend execution
package_plan.package_network: NONE; no resolver or downloader entry point in v2. Offline uv consumes existing v1 SHA-bound archives.
package_plan.package_lock_scope: Reuse unchanged v1 lock solely as immutable package/source/runtime identity; v2 protocol/ID/attempt/output directory are independent.

import_plan.repository_helper_resolution: Verify exact helper SHA set at authorization and immediately before use; append ROOT/tools temporarily after all metric/runtime/stdlib paths; verify module origins before execution and after import; remove helper path afterward.

source_contract: Verify original condition image SHA and source-specific dimension; no camera instructions in current six-source cohort. No image/video model or decoder is called.
attempt_accounting: exclusive new v2 ATTEMPT and IMPORT_ATTEMPT files; one separately registered attempt; no implicit retry/fallback or old v1 mutation
success_does_not_establish: forward numerical equivalence with R17 or any other environment
v1 installation failure had no scientific or model-numerical content
next_model_scope: Separate bounded checkpoint/forward compatibility scope after this report; no automatic model execution.

previous_attempt.failure: FileNotFoundError from a concurrently removed uv temporary directory during pathlib.rglob accounting; child terminated before metric import phase.
previous_attempt.preservation: v1 source/protocol/lock/receipts remain immutable; v2 references v1 package archives read-only and verifies their SHA before and after installation.

resource_accounting.algorithm: os.scandir with DirEntry.stat(follow_symlinks=False), regular files only; directory snapshots are non-atomic; symlinked runtime is excluded.
resource_accounting.transient_error_tolerated: errno.ENOENT only during child directory enumeration or entry stat
resource_accounting.final_accounting_error: write failed receipt containing accounting errno, then rethrow; do not report an unknown total as zero.
real_race_regressions: real thread removes real directory after queue insertion before child scandir
real thread removes real entry after parent scandir before lstat
resource_accounting.permission_regression: actual chmod000 unreadable directory plus explicit EACCES/EIO/ENOTDIR propagation tests
